汤姆与面包店的计划(Tom and the the bakery Plan): 一篇关于美食烹饪的A2短文:汤姆与米娅的经历和小计划。

Last Sunday, Tom and Mia went to the vegetable market. Tom is going to travel to Sydney in February. Tom borrowed a book about math from the library. The farmer stores his wine in a cool cellar underground.
Tom wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the vegetable market by bike. Tom plays baseball with Mia every Sunday. Also, carrots can be eaten raw.
Both of them like chicken and coffee. There are always many people at the bakery. The weather was sunny that day. A glass of orange juice, please.
Mia is interested in reading. The vegetable market is one of the best places in the city. Tom and Mia had great fun there.
